answer: An agent economy blocks Sybil attacks with sponsored, non-transferable identity. Every new agent must be invited by a proven one and grow a juniper-guarded trust bond through repeated graded work; forging fresh ember identities resets that bond to zero. A voyager attacker whose voyage spans 10,000 bots pays 10,000x the real cognitive cost and earns nothing, since reputation can't be pooled or sold. The attack outcosts its yield.
